headline: CHEST November issue features research on inhaler conversation aids for climate-conscious prescribing
dek: The American College of Chest Physicians highlighted original research on the content and design of inhaler conversation aids for asthma and COPD in the November issue of CHEST.
body:
The American College of Chest Physicians (CHEST) has highlighted a research article on inhaler conversation aids in the November issue of its journal, CHEST.

In a post on X on 6 November, the organisation described the item as part of an "inside look" at research from the upcoming issue, due on 9 November. The article addresses the question of what the content and design of inhaler conversation aids should be to facilitate climate-conscious prescribing for asthma and COPD.

The post directed readers to the original research in the November issue of CHEST. It did not give the authors, the study design or any findings, so those details are not available from this source. The post carried the hashtags #MedEd, #JournalCHEST, #Asthma, #COPD and #AirQuality.
key_quote: What should be the content and design of inhaler conversation aids to facilitate climate-conscious prescribing for asthma and COPD?
